audit.why: Emerald+ 48.89% over 585 games, slightly under even, and both charts hand Jayce Levels 2-3 and the item windows while giving Neeko nothing outright — which is honest for a lane decided by whether one 1000-range root lands rather than by stats.

Level 6 is correctly called her flip: Jayce's R is the stance-swap he already had, while Pop Blossom is a 120s dash-knockup-stun at 600 range. The 2+ items call is also right — full-AP Neeko out-scales a Jayce who buys no defensive stats.

audit.whatIsWrong: `spikes[0].text`, `wants.you[0]` and `whys[1]` all put the Armor/MR shred on a 'Cannon-to-Hammer' swap. The direction is backwards.
audit.why: Riot: from Hammer Stance the swap becomes Mercury Cannon and 'the first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist'; from Cannon Stance it becomes Mercury Hammer and that first attack 'deals additional magic damage'. The shred is the first attack after swapping INTO Cannon. Against a Neeko who buys MR to survive the poke this is the button that undoes the buy, and three separate strings tell the player to press it in the wrong direction on a 6-second toggle.
audit.corrected: The shred is the first attack after swapping into Mercury Cannon; the Hammer first hit is bonus magic damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: `wants.you[1]` and `mid` both tell you to hold Thundering Blow for 'the Pop Blossom wind-up'. Riot's own text says that wind-up is not always visible.
audit.why: Pop Blossom description: 'After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air... The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' So the exact scenario the page trains you for — she is disguised as an ally, you do not see her coming — is the one where the tell you were told to react to does not exist. The reaction has to be to the disguise, not to the wind-up: an ally-model champion walking at you in a lane it has no business being in IS the wind-up. Inherent Glamour also breaks the disguise when she takes immobilizing crowd control or casts a damaging spell, so Thundering Blow's knockback is a way to test a suspicious model rather than only a peel button.
audit.corrected: The Pop Blossom wind-up is invisible while she is disguised — react to the unexplained ally model, and use the knockback to break the disguise.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is named as the ability the lane is traded around and its cooldown and range appear nowhere.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 at 1000 range, and Riot adds that passing through a champion makes it 'larger, faster, and roots for longer'. Two consequences the page misses: 12 seconds at rank 1 is the actual poke window, and standing behind your own minions or a teammate makes the root that reaches you strictly worse than a clean one — so the minion line is not just a shield here, it is a root-duration reduction. Pop Blossom is 120s at rank 1 and Thundering Blow 20s.
audit.corrected: Tangle-Barbs 12s at rank 1, 1000 range, and it upgrades through units — Pop Blossom 120s, Thundering Blow 20s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer calls Neeko 'he'/'his' in dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[2].t and breakdown.trading.
audit.why: Neeko is female and Riot's ability text uses 'she' and 'her' throughout. On a page whose central mechanic is her disguising as someone else, getting her pronouns wrong reads as a page written by someone who has not seen the champion.
audit.corrected: Corrected in the strings edited here; the rest listed in notes.

edits.after: Unlocking Acceleration Gate turns Shock Blast into the full-range accelerated orb — fire it through the gate as she steps up to last-hit her Blooming Burst CS, then swap INTO Mercury Cannon so that first attack shreds her Armor/MR, and chunk her for free before Tangle-Barbs is ranked to threaten back.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1, 1000 range, and it gets larger, faster and roots longer after passing through anything — stand behind minions. - Pop Blossom: 120s, and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. - Thundering Blow: 20s.

notes: Packet flagged three suspect names here — 'Hold Thundering Blow', "Pop Blossom's" and 'Save Thundering Blow'. All three are false positives; the names are spelled exactly as Riot has them and the checker was matching the surrounding verb or the possessive. The genuine errors were the reversed stance-swap direction (three strings) and the Pop Blossom hidden-wind-up interaction. Remaining misgendering I did not touch, all full layer: dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[2].t ('Eat his Tangle-Barbs in cannon form'), breakdown.trading, tradeGood, tldr and winCon all say 'he'/'him'.
